newsitem.title: GERMANY: Buba vice-president sees no need for rate change.
newsitem.headline: Buba vice-president sees no need for rate change.

text.p: Bundesbank vice-president Johann-Wilhelm Gaddum said on Friday he saw no need for a change in German interest rates at present.
In a German radio interview Gaddum said: "There is no reason for the Bundesbank to change interest rates, even if the U.S. central bank raises interest rates in May."

Repeating a message delivered at the Bundesbank's annual news conference on Thursday, Gaddum said the Bundesbank would continue to steer German monetary policy independently of moves by the Federal Reserve.
